notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°11
notes.content:
[h1]Big Update ![/h1]
[h1]The game version is now V0.7.0.[/h1]
[h1]Added a new game rule. The Safe and The Lethal Zones. You can have more info in the "how to play" section in-game.[/h1]
[h1]Added a minimap that show the entire island.[/h1]
[h1]Added hunger and thirst. You can have more info in the "how to play" section in-game.[/h1]
The Multiplayer mode will be disabled for the moment because of some bugs found.
Adjusted the Firlyn stone explosion effect.
Adjusted the AIs.
Changed the underwater color.

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°10
notes.content:
Fixed some problems affecting your power.
Fixed some problems affecting the music.
Fixed some problems affecting the spawning of the guards.
Added a new animation when you use your power.
Augmented your power's jump speed.
Reduced the delay in using your power from 60 to 45 seconds.
Changed the color of the capture bar when you are capturing an objective.
There's now day time not night time when you start a match.

[h1]Your stats are now deleted once, the new level system is now on this update.[/h1]
As always, have fun.

notes.title: Warning : Next Update Will Delete All Your Stats
notes.content:
ːreddangerːThe next update that I will make on the game will "destroy" your levels, stats but not your achievements. It's for implementing the new Level Systemːreddangerː

As always, have fun !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°9
notes.content:
Added more Steam achievements.
Reduced the guard's flashed time from 3 to 1.7 seconds.
Augmented guard's max sprint speed from 24km/h to 30km/h.
Rain will no more appear underwater.

notes.title: Bug found : Can't create a multiplayer session !
notes.content:
ːreddangerː If you can't create a multiplayer session, follow these steps below ! ːreddangerː
[olist]
[*] Go to folder explorer, options, display and enable hidden folders.
[*] Go to C:/Users/"You"/Appdata/Local/TFS_Multiplayer and delete the "Saved" folder.
[/olist]
[h1]Warning : this will delete your stats in-game like your level, your character name and customization but will not delete the Steam achievements.[/h1]

If you need more help to do the steps above, talk to me on Discord via : discord.gg/67ufmK3
The screenshots to do the steps above are on Discord !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°7
notes.content:
[h1]Added "Health", "Stamina" and "Power" abilities. The Powers are coming soon.[/h1]
Added some flowers in the landscape.
Augmented the number of Firlyn stones to collect from 20 to 30 in solo mode and from +8 to +15 stones per player connected in multiplayer mode.
Augmented the number of Firlyn stones spawned from 2150 to 3500.
If someone disconnects from a multiplayer session, everyone will be "Defeated".
Fixed a problem that when you win or lose in multiplayer, only the creator of the session will see the "Victory" or "Defeat" appear. Now, the creator of the session and the people who joined this session will see the "Victory" or "Defeat" appear.
Fixed a crash when you exit the game.
Changed the key to open the settings panel in-game from "P" to "Escape".

As always, have fun !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°6
notes.content:
Fixed a problem that makes the game lag when you spawn on the map.
Fixed a problem in multiplayer that your head doesn't rotate correctly.
Fixed a problem in multiplayer that when you join a game, then you go underwater, you fall like if you were on the ground.
Removed the capability of swimming to the left and to the right.
Reduced poison timer from 3.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
Adjusted graphics settings.

As always, have fun !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°5
notes.content:
- Added sand trees and algae undrwater.
- Fixed the map, you were able to see the end of the map, now there's a end.
- Fixed an error that the achievement "First Escape" could not execute.
- Adjusted the graphics of the game, now more computer will have the game fluid.

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°4
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that makes the "defeat" pop-up don't appear when you lose.
- Fixed underwater speed that makes you faster when you press the "forward" and "left or right" buttons.
As always, have fun !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°3
notes.content:
- Fixed the ambient music. The music mixes but it should not.
- Fixed the AI system underwater. When the guards enter the water they stops immediately.
- Added new grass, that grass takes less memory so the game is more fluid.
As always, have fun !

notes.title: The Firlyn Stones - Developpment Notes N°1
notes.content:
Hello.
At the moment, I'm working on some improvements and fixing bugs.
The only bug that I discovered is : 
- The guards don't appear on the map but outside the map. The error at the moment is now fixed.

For the improvements I changed the default AZERTY keyboard inputs to a QWERTY keyboard inputs. Later on, I'll make a menu to customize the keyboard inputs.

As always, have fun !
